newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac in A$340 mln securitise deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac in A$340 mln securitise deal.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Monday it and Societe Generale Australia Ltd had finalised the A$340 million securitisation of a Westpac mortgage product into Societe Generale's new residential mortgage securitisation vehicle.
Westpac said the mortgages to be securitised were from its Basic Option home loan and the SocGen vehicle would be launched in the near future.
The deal was the first securitisation of a major Australian bank's residential mortgage portfolio, SocGen executive Greg Medcraft said.
"Westpac has spent many months planning and building the operational infrastructure to support securitisation," Westpac group treasurer Martin Touw said.
"When the opportunity came to securitise the loans to Societe Generale, Westpac was in a position to finalise the transaction and securitise the loans within six weeks," Touw said.
